description: Use this when the user asks when a UAE VAT return is due or must be paid for a month or quarter, or what their next VAT deadline is from the period alone. The UAE VAT return filing and payment deadline for a tax period: 28 days after the period ends (the 28th of the following month), moved to the next working day for a weekend or UAE public holiday, with days left. Give one of period_end (a date), month (a monthly period) or quarter_ending (the last month of a quarter). With none, returns the current and next periods for period_type and quarter_group (default quarterly, March/June/September/December). Do not use it for a connected business's own VAT figures or unfiled periods (get_vat_summary, get_whats_due).

period_end.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the last day of the tax period.

quarter_ending.description: YYYY-MM: the last month of a quarterly tax period.

quarter_group.description: The months your quarters end in, as shown in EmaraTax.

name: vat_filing_deadline
title: UAE VAT return deadline
